notablePrerequisites: You control seven or more lands with different names.
easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Leyline of Transformation.
description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
The permanent that entered is a Saproling through Leyline of Transformation and a Forest in addition to its other types due to Life and Limb, causing Field of the Dead to trigger.
Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.
